_comment: Mutation testing of the reference decision core; see docs/CONFORMANCE-COVERAGE.md. node:test has no per-test coverage hook for Stryker, so the command runner reruns the suite for every mutant. The command is three stages joined by &&, cheapest first: the portable vectors (npm run conformance), the fast unit and property files, then the slower files that only run for mutants that survived both. A mutant is killed by the first stage that fails.

commandRunner.command: node conformance/run.ts && node --test --test-concurrency=2 tests/mutation-core.test.ts tests/mutation-core-2.test.ts tests/conformance.test.ts tests/conformance-authzen.test.ts tests/hardening.test.ts tests/decisions.test.ts tests/destinations.test.ts tests/runtime-containment.test.ts tests/regressions-0.6.test.ts tests/identity.test.ts tests/knowledge.test.ts tests/knowledge-monotonicity.test.ts tests/interop.test.ts tests/vector.test.ts tests/authzen.test.ts && node --test --test-concurrency=2 tests/differential-fuzz.test.ts tests/differential-knowledge.test.ts tests/kb.test.ts tests/lifecycle.test.ts tests/admin-lifecycle.test.ts
